name: Pacific View
demographics: Pacific View attracts a diverse mix of Ventura County residents and coastal visitors, with a strong representation of middle to upper-middle income families and young professionals aged 25-54. The trade area draws from Ventura's affluent coastal neighborhoods and surrounding communities, with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000+. Shoppers tend to favor a blend of convenience and experience, seeking both everyday retail needs and dining entertainment options in an open-air coastal setting.
description: Pacific View is Ventura's premier open-air shopping destination, offering a vibrant mix of retail stores, restaurants, and entertainment options along East Main Street. This lifestyle center provides a welcoming atmosphere where visitors can enjoy a diverse selection of shopping experiences, from popular national retailers to local favorites, all in a convenient coastal California setting. The center features an extensive food and drink scene with both full-service restaurants and bars alongside fast-casual dining options, making it a popular gathering spot for both locals and visitors. With its accessible location in Ventura and thoughtfully designed layout, Pacific View serves as a community hub where shopping, dining, and entertainment come together seamlessly. The center maintains convenient operating hours and offers a range of amenities including events programming, making it a go-to destination for Ventura County residents seeking a complete retail and lifestyle experience.
summary: Pacific View is Ventura's premier open-air lifestyle center featuring a diverse mix of retail stores, restaurants, and entertainment options. Located on East Main Street, this shopping destination serves as a vibrant community hub for both everyday shopping needs and leisure activities.
